_why: Skill-candidates row '`--check-anchors` should sweep every spec directory by default': a habitual one-directory sweep said ANCHORS_OK while `h-mad/tests/specs/` had drifted. A no-argument `--check-anchors` now discovers every committed spec through `git ls-files` and the classifier. These rows prove the tests bite if discovery narrows back to one directory, admits untracked files, or turns a failed discovery into an empty (vacuous) sweep. The untracked-spec rows (skill-candidates `untracked-spec-warning`) prove the stderr advisory names a forgotten spec, stays off the parsed stdout, ignores non-specs, ignored files and named specs, and fails loud when git cannot list.
command: no_spec or without_a_spec or exactly_one or untracked_specs

mutations.name: discovery-narrows-to-one-directory
mutations._mechanism: The defect the row records, restored: only `mutation-specs/` is swept and a drifted `specs/` spec is invisible.
mutations.find: paths = sorted(repo / rel for rel in listed.stdout.split("\0") if rel)
mutations.replace: paths = sorted(repo / rel for rel in listed.stdout.split("\0") if rel and "/mutation-specs/" in "/" + rel)

mutations.name: discovery-failure-becomes-an-empty-sweep
mutations._mechanism: Fail-open: git cannot answer, the sweep gets [] and reports NOTHING_SWEPT instead of saying discovery failed.
mutations.find:
if top.returncode != 0:
        raise SpecError(f"could not discover committed specs: {top.stderr.strip()}")

mutations.name: discovery-walks-the-filesystem-not-the-index
mutations._mechanism: An untracked scratch spec joins the sweep, so a committed-only property reads someone's local file.
mutations.find: paths = sorted(repo / rel for rel in listed.stdout.split("\0") if rel)

mutations.name: non-specs-are-swept-as-noise
mutations._mechanism: Every tracked JSON prints a SKIPPED line, burying the findings the sweep exists to show.
mutations.find: return [p for p in paths if classify_spec_file(p)[0] != "not-a-spec"]

mutations.name: untracked-advisory-never-printed
mutations._mechanism: The silent skip the row records, restored.

mutations.name: untracked-advisory-on-parsed-stdout
mutations._mechanism: The note lands on stdout, where the suite and pre-push hook parse ANCHORS lines by exact string.
mutations.find:
print(f"[H-MAD] note: untracked spec not swept: {rel} — `git add` it to include it",
              file=sys.stderr)
mutations.replace: print(f"[H-MAD] note: untracked spec not swept: {rel} — `git add` it to include it")

mutations.name: untracked-advisory-names-non-specs
mutations._mechanism: Every untracked JSON is reported, so the note becomes noise people learn to ignore.

mutations.name: untracked-advisory-names-ignored-files
mutations._mechanism: Without --exclude-standard a deliberately ignored spec is reported as forgotten.

mutations.name: untracked-advisory-on-named-specs
mutations._mechanism: Named specs are swept tracked or not; warning there reports a skip that did not happen.

mutations.name: untracked-listing-failure-reads-as-none
mutations._mechanism: Fail-open: git cannot list, the advisory says nothing, which reads as nothing untracked.
mutations.find:
if listed.returncode != 0:
        raise SpecError(f"could not list untracked specs: {listed.stderr.strip()}")

mutations.name: untracked-listing-scoped-to-cwd
mutations._mechanism: Without the `:/` anchor git lists only under cwd, so `cd h-mad && --check-anchors` misses a spec forgotten in a sibling directory.

mutations.name: untracked-half-written-spec-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Only fully valid specs are named; the half-written one, likeliest to be untracked, is skipped in silence.

mutations.name: untracked-undecodable-file-crashes-sweep
mutations._mechanism: Review must-fix restored: a UTF-16 untracked JSON raises UnicodeDecodeError and the sweep prints no verdict.

mutations.name: untracked-listing-failure-crashes-sweep
mutations._mechanism: The advisory's own failure escapes and takes the anchor verdict down with it.

mutations.name: sweep-untracked-advisory-never-printed
mutations._mechanism: The bare --sweep keeps the silent skip the row named.
mutations.find:
print(f"SWEEP: INCOMPLETE specs=0 — {exc}")
            return 2
        if not args.spec:
            _warn_untracked_specs(Path.cwd())

mutations.name: sweep-untracked-advisory-on-named-specs
mutations._mechanism: A sweep of named specs reports a skip that did not happen.
mutations.find:
print(f"SWEEP: INCOMPLETE specs=0 — {exc}")
            return 2
        if not args.spec:
            _warn_untracked_specs(Path.cwd())

mutations.name: isolate-copy-skips-untracked
mutations._mechanism: The detached worktree gets only HEAD plus the diff, so the child never sees the untracked spec and the bare --sweep --isolate stays silent.

mutations.name: isolate-child-stderr-swallowed
mutations._mechanism: The child warns, but its stderr never reaches the caller.
